title: Examples: test agents built with LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Pydantic AI or CrewAI (Agent-Threat-Rule/atr-eval)
raw_text:
Examples: test agents built with LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Pydantic AI or CrewAI — open-source issue in Agent-Threat-Rule/atr-eval. Labels: help wanted. ATR Eval can test any agent that loads an MCP config and takes a task, through `--agent command` and an `agent.yaml` ([README, "Test your own agent"](https://github.com/Agent-Threat-Rule/atr-eval#test-your-own-agent)). There are no examples yet for common agent frameworks, so their users have to work out the glue themselves. One example per framework; comment with the one you are taking, or just open a draft pull request.

- [ ] LangGraph (for example with `langchain-mcp-adapters`)
- [ ] OpenAI

title: Add a Colab notebook that measures meta-d' for an open model (kishoren18-hue/metad-llm)
raw_text:
Add a Colab notebook that measures meta-d' for an open model — open-source issue in kishoren18-hue/metad-llm. Labels: documentation, good first issue. Many people who'd use metad-llm want to try it on a real model without setting anything up. A notebook that runs top to bottom in Google Colab would be the fastest way in.

**What to build**

`examples/colab_open_model.ipynb` that:

1. Installs metad-llm from GitHub
2. Loads a small open model with `transformers` (something that runs on Colab's free GPU)
